decision: Direct causal-score magnitude is not a reliable capital-weight signal. Proportional admission slightly improves union but materially reduces common-five and leader-removal wealth. Do not search score exponents, temperatures or fixed weight ratios.
next_direction: Refine the current campaign-peak displacement authority itself: protect an incumbent at its funded peak only when it is also the stronger currently funded campaign, instead of protecting any weaker secondary campaign merely because it is at a local peak.
evidence_readback: Dedicated hosted workflow completed TDD, source-bound measurement, artifact upload, research/evidence append and remote SHA read-back successfully.
